newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Mostly up on slow sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Mostly up on slow sales.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were mostly higher Thursday, with strength tied mostly to continued slow producer selling, merchandisers said.
"I hope we get some grain soon," one Montana dealer said.
Some cash sources also reported active dealings in railcar markets.
"We saw good rail movement today (Thursday), and the basis was a little weaker," one Minneapolis-based dealer said.
The late gains in MGE spring wheat were expected to spur late producer selling, dealers said. The March wheat closed up 4-1/2 cents per bushel at 3.77-3/4.
"I don't think many farmers knew about the rally or there would have been more selling," a merchandiser said.
